objective: Climb the Five Winds at the new moon: bring the ones who remember you
title: The Hollow Court
summary: The new moon, a Ledger with a blank line, and the people who remember you standing in the way.

steps.title: The Hollow Court
steps.sub: The new moon over the Five Winds

say: Everybody's here. The whole academy is in the dark on a mountain, and I didn't even have to be loud about it.
Mikage will want to speak first. Let her. She has had four hundred years to prepare, and it would be rude.
You came. I did hope you would. It is so dull to take a name from someone who isn't watching.
I will tell you why, since you have climbed so far. The Court was not made to hurt anyone. It was made to forget a war.
We wrote the worst of it out of every mind that remembered. The Seal is the lock, and the lock needs a keeper who will never remember what is inside. That keeper was always meant to be hollow.
You are asking a child to be nobody, so that everyone else may be somebody.
I am asking one to be nobody so that all of you may sleep. I have been nobody for three hundred years, and I assure you it is survivable.

lines: I don't want to forget anyone. I just got everyone.
I'll remind you every day, if I have to. Loudly.
Then we will do this the hard way, and I regret it more than any of you will know.

beats.taunt: A name is only a sound. I have kept the sound of mine for no one.

phases.say: Wind, which forgets everything it carries.
Lightning, which remembers only the instant.
And water, which has been trying to tell me something for three hundred years.

lines: ...Say it. Say my name, any of you. I want to hear whether it is still a name.
Mikage. You wrote my sister out of my house, and I will never forgive you, and I am saying it anyway.
...Oh. It is. It is still a name.
Come down the mountain. The academy has a council, and a place at it for the people who have been lonely the longest.
I have a Ledger to put right. It will take me a long time.
We have a lot of lanterns.

beats.text: The End  ·  The Court is hollow no longer
